profile.reading: This record is named Switch: The Rock in this registry, mapped to Williamson County, Texas, near Georgetown and Round Rock. The operator own Austin area page names this same facility The Rock directly, located at Dell Technologies global headquarters, with up to 1.5 million square feet of data center space, up to 2 MW per cabinet, 100 percent renewable energy, and a 100 percent power uptime guarantee. The page also notes the operator acquired Data Foundry locations in Austin and Houston in 2021 to anchor a fifth PRIME campus expansion in the Texas market.
profile.capacity_note: Operator states up to 1.5 million square feet and up to 2 MW per cabinet, not a total facility MW figure.
